gloss: how something looks on screen or in photos; image quality

definitions.gloss: how something looks on screen or in photos; image quality
definitions.explanation: The way something appears when photographed, filmed, or reflected.

definitions.gloss: how well things go together; harmony of appearance
definitions.explanation: The way colors, patterns, or items complement each other visually.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧ (to be reflected, to appear on screen). Describes how something looks when reflected, photographed, or displayed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {映|うつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: looks good (on screen/in photos), photogenic
- {映|うつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: looks bad (on screen/in photos)
- ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{映|うつ}り: TV picture quality
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{映|うつ}り: how one looks in photos

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{写|うつ}り→写り：20375_utsuri⟧: how something looks in a photograph — written with a different kanji but pronounced the same; the two are often used interchangeably for photos
- ⟦{見栄|みば}え→見栄え：09044_mibae⟧: visual appeal, appearance — focuses on how attractive something looks overall

USAGE:
{映|うつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ is commonly used to compliment someone who looks good in photos. This is different from the person being attractive in general — it specifically refers to how well the camera captures them.
